login.title: Sign in to TRUSCA
login.subtitle: Continue to your projects and scans.

demo.title: Exploring the live demo?
demo.detail: Sign in with the demo account below to browse a portal seeded with real components, licenses, and vulnerabilities. Writes are disabled.
demo.password_note: This password works for every seeded demo account.
demo.scan_note: To run a live scan or upload a BomLens SBOM, sign in as dev@demo.trustedoss.dev — the Demo Sandbox project is only visible to that account.

login.session_expired: Your session ended, so you were signed out. Sign in to pick up where you left off.

mfa.prompt: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recovery_hint: Lost your device? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Sign up to start managing open-source risk for your team.

demo.title: Sign-up is disabled on the live demo
demo.detail: This public demo is read-only, so it does not create accounts. Sign in with the shared demo account below to browse a portal seeded with real components, licenses, and vulnerabilities.
demo.password_note: This password works for every seeded demo account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link if the account exists.
forgot.success: If that email is registered, we've sent a reset link. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Set a new password for your account.
reset.info: Choose a password with at least 8 characters.

errors.missing_token: This reset link is invalid or incomplete. Request a new one to continue.
errors.invalid: This reset link is invalid or has already been used. Request a new one.
errors.expired: This reset link has expired. Request a new one to continue.

errors.denied: Sign-in was cancelled at the provider. Try again or use email and password.
errors.invalid_state: The sign-in session was invalid or expired. Try again.
errors.failed: We couldn't complete the sign-in with the provider. Try again.
errors.user_inactive: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
errors.no_organization: No organization is configured. Contact your administrator.
errors.missing_params: The sign-in callback was missing required information.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong during sign-in. Try again.

errors.password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Wait and try again, or reset your password.
errors.too_many_attempts_wait_one: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in about a minute, or reset your password.
errors.too_many_attempts_wait_other: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in about {{count}} minutes, or reset your password.
errors.too_many_attempts_wait: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in about a minute, or reset your password.

gateway.pitch: Know what open source you run and where the risk is — vulnerabilities, licences and SBOMs.

trust.hosting: Apache-2.0 and self-hosted: your source and your findings stay on your own infrastructure.
trust.sources: Vulnerability data from NVD, OSV and GHSA, with EPSS scores and the CISA known-exploited catalogue.
trust.formats: SBOMs in CycloneDX and SPDX, generated from the same scan you triage.
